items.original_title: North Korea seeks power for security, not supremacy, Kim says
items.rss_summary:
Kim Jong-un said North Korea would strive to achieve “power and capability” to ensure its security and peace but would not pursue supremacy, state media reported on Monday.
Kim made the remarks at a ceremony to receive credentials from newly appointed ambassadors – including Russia’s – in a rare departure from protocol, as the task has traditionally been performed by a senior official rather than Kim himself.
The ceremony followed Kim’s snubbing of US President Donald Trump’s overtures last week
